notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Update Patch Notes

New & Improved!

- More Checkpoints in Easy Mode. Practice just got smoother! We've added extra checkpoints to make 
your experience more accessible and frustration-free.
- Coins Now Save on Collection. No more losing your hard-earned coins! They are now properly saved 
once collected.
- Collision Update. Touch the ground, even with a foot? You're out! This improves game fairness and consistency.
- Improved Friction & Braking. No more unintended sliding! We've fine-tuned movement to give you better control on all surfaces.

Fixes & Optimizations

- Multiplayer Title Replication Fixed. Titles now display correctly for all players.
- Countdown Bug Fixed. The countdown timer now behaves properly after matches start.
- Private Sessions No Longer Appear in Search. Hidden lobbies stay hidden as intended.
- Various Visual & Sound Fixes. A smoother, more immersive experience with multiple tweaks and improvements.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Happy jumping!
